items.title: FindConfig
items.description:
An object that is used to configure how an entity is retrieved from the database. It accepts as a typed parameter an `Entity` class,
which provides correct typing of field names in its properties.

items.title: BaseFilterable
items.description: An object used to allow specifying flexible queries with and/or conditions.

items.title: SoftDeleteReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be soft-deleted when the main entity is soft-deleted.

items.title: RestoreReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be restored when the main entity is restored.

items.title: Context
items.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

items.title: FilterableUserProps
items.description: The filters to apply on the retrieved user.

items.title: UpdateUserDTO
items.description: The attributes to update in the user.

items.title: UpdateInviteDTO
items.description: The attributes to update in the invite.

items.title: IUserModuleService
items.description: The main service interface for the User Module.

items.title: FindConfigOrder
items.description: Temporary type fixing to allow any level of orders until we get to properly clean all the types

items.title: Message
items.description: The details of an event to emit.
